0.0.4.summary: Offline series management with dedicated episode navigation, playback controls, remote dynamic environment config, and Google Play DEX code optimization.
added: Dedicated Series Details screen for offline downloads with grouped episodes and bulk download actions
Next and Previous episode playback controls for both streaming and offline downloaded media
Auto-play next movie in downloads when finishing offline movie playback
Remote environment configuration (.env) hydrated dynamically from version.json without needing app rebuilds
Two-tier update engine: seamless background OTA soft updates and in-app APK installer
Hidden adult content toggle unlocked via security keyword
changed: Downloads tab groups series titles on top with badge counts and navigation to the new series episode viewer
Improved player controls layout and bottom navigation bar styling
fixed: Google Play Console DEX code optimization warning resolved via R8 minification and resource shrinking
ProGuard rules configured for React Native and Hermes runtime stability

0.0.3.summary: A faster, clearer way to browse, watch, and continue titles across mobile and web.
added: Watch progress on movie details and episode borders
Local watch history with the latest 30 videos grouped by date
Related title suggestions with Show more and Show less
Hold the player for temporary 2x playback
Player volume and screen brightness swipe gestures
changed: Catalog and search results now return to title Details without losing search results
Recent searches keep the complete query, including multi-word searches
Downloads show both download progress and watched progress
Playback speed keeps the selected rate and restores it after a temporary 2x hold
fixed: Completed episodes now remain visibly marked as 100% watched
Video audio pitch stays natural when playback speed changes
Series and movie detail layouts no longer become unwieldy with many episodes
Long update descriptions now scroll while the update buttons stay visible
